text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Dr Farrell, Tina, and Chris for reassuring clients through difficult surgical decisions. Reviewers describe how the team explains complex orthopaedic procedures with clarity and empathy. Multiple clients highlight that the staff remains attentive and supportive throughout pre-operative preparation and post-surgical recovery.

Clients report remarkable recovery outcomes for dogs undergoing TPLO and torn cruciate ligament repairs. Reviewers emphasize seeing pets transition from severe lameness to walking, running, and playing within weeks of surgery. Pet parents express immense relief at the mobility restored to their dogs following corrective orthopaedic interventions.

Owners highlight the detailed guidance provided for at-home recovery, including video demonstrations and exercise schedules. Reviewers note that staff proactively checked in via text message and remained readily available to answer recovery questions. Clients value this transparent communication when managing post-operative convalescence.

q.en: What surgical procedures are commonly performed at this clinic?

a.en: Reviewers primarily describe orthopaedic surgeries including TPLO, cruciate ligament repair, and luxating patella correction.

q.en: How do clients rate the surgery costs compared to other clinics?

a.en: Multiple clients report that all-inclusive surgical pricing was substantially more affordable than estimates received elsewhere.

q.en: Does the clinic provide aftercare support following operations?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight follow-up text messages, clear exercise plans, and readily accessible staff during recovery.

q.en: Do pets typically walk on the same day as their surgery?

a.en: Reviewers mention that their dogs were able to walk out of the facility on the afternoon of their procedure.
